definitions.oneball: the 200 one-ball test scenes the ceiling was measured on; a rollout stops at 10 mm, as that measurement did
definitions.twoball: the 200 two-ball test scenes; a catch is either ball; episodes run to the end of the flight
definitions.weight: execute the mean of the highest-weight component
definitions.continue_rule: at each replan, execute the component whose next second is closest, in normalized actions, to the unexecuted part of the chunk in progress
definitions.between_miss: among two-ball misses, the hand at its closest approach was nearer the midpoint than either ball

train: two-ball episodes only, K=5 diagonal Gaussians, negative log-likelihood
